title: Regular Income (SWP)
shortText: Withdraw a fixed amount every month while staying invested.
whatItIs: A Systematic Withdrawal Plan redeems a fixed amount from your mutual fund investment every month or quarter and credits it to your bank account. The remaining units stay invested. Each withdrawal is a redemption, so only the gain portion is subject to capital gains tax.
whoItSuits: Retirees and others who want a regular cash flow from an existing corpus and understand that the corpus can reduce if withdrawals exceed returns.
howItWorks: Decide the monthly amount you need and the corpus available
Use the SWP calculator to see an illustrative month-by-month balance
Invest the corpus in suitable schemes and register the SWP
Review the withdrawal rate with your relationship manager every year

faqs.question: Is SWP income fixed?
faqs.answer: The withdrawal amount is fixed, but the value of your remaining investment varies with markets and is not guaranteed.

faqs.question: How is SWP taxed?
faqs.answer: Each instalment is a redemption; tax applies to the gain on the units redeemed, depending on the scheme type and holding period.
